summary: Completed the bounded architecture/documentation review of the proposed XTK Systems office deployment. No supported actionable findings were identified. The plan describes available runtime adapters accurately, identifies its missing preflight and PostgreSQL/local-file recovery preparation, and keeps provisioning, capacity, and production admission conditional.
evidence: Source: HEAD e3149dd11f1fa67b4955b4eec3d998aa82be284e; docs/live-deployment-plan.md SHA256 1795013e045861e7b79c1560b30b8a12067ccf128367b7e462d5f12aa3b9a553; all plan file digests match: true.
Review: review/review.json; verdict pass; supported findings 0.
limitations: This is a source/documentation review, not a deployment acceptance or performance result. No builds, tests, service/container/VM operations, credential access, provider account calls or live infrastructure changes were performed.

Application-security reassessment, exploit reproduction and retrying the previous interrupted security work were outside this assignment. Existing F01-F11/T01 findings and the previous release hold are unchanged.

Physical host identity, Windows Server versions, support state, free CPU/RAM/storage under VDI load, network route, UPS, backup destination and recovery objectives are unverified. Proposed VM allocations are not minimum requirements or measured capacity.

Production Compose, the office preflight profile, secret injection, ingress/certificate setup, backup scheduling and the PostgreSQL/local-file recovery runbook remain future work explicitly gated in the plan. No exact-topology recovery, real Google login or VDI browser acceptance was executed.

The existing pilot worksheet is a generic hosted/PostgreSQL-object-storage template. Office-specific host, filesystem, recovery and acceptance evidence will need to be recorded during the planned preparation and staging work.
Vendor documentation was read publicly; tenant-specific service configuration, subscription entitlements and operational availability were not inspected.
